name: storage sanity v0 and prototype console
output: StorageSanityProbe + StorageSanityEvidence + Prototype Console + fixture replay mode

storage_sanity.question: can a genuine reservation reach the amount policy already decided to allow?

implementations.replayed-no-allocation: scripted outcomes for fixture mode and tests

storage_sanity.trigger: reported free >= 1 TiB AND the family's reported size is not credible. A flag only; a read never probes
storage_sanity.ladder: 8, 16, 32, 64 GiB — last rung is the policy ceiling

policy_interaction.partial: policy bound stands; a budget expiring proves nothing about the pool
policy_interaction.failure_below_policy: capacity reduced to the verified lower bound

storage_sanity.result_shape: verified lower bound, optional observed failure upper bound, UNKNOWN upper bound; never a midpoint
storage_sanity.failure_classification: only ENOSPC and EDQUOT bound capacity; EOPNOTSUPP is an absence of method
storage_sanity.persistence: after every rung, before the next begins
storage_sanity.cleanup: removed in finally, confirmed by path absence, never by a free-space delta; orphans cleared before each probe
storage_sanity.execution: explicit only — CLI `kultrun storage sanity-check` and POST /v1/storage/sanity-check; unreachable by GET

prototype_console.technology: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript; no framework, no build step
prototype_console.route: /prototype, served by the HTTP adapter from the same artifact

fixture_replay_mode.amendment: the console must work locally by default; a rented host is a laboratory, not a home
fixture_replay_mode.runs_real_logic: real parsers, normalization, capacity policy and sanity controller; only the evidence source and the reservation primitive are substituted

reproduces_reference_host.accelerator: 31.9 GiB -> 23.9 GiB, one assigned of four visible

fixture_replay_mode.never_presented_as_live: every surface reports evidence_mode, physical_host_connected and storage_evidence_kind

local_acceptance.capacity_after: policy_cap_verified and still 64 GiB — confirmed, not expanded

defects_found_by_looking: index.html referenced assets relatively, so at /prototype without a trailing slash the browser resolved app.js to /app.js, 404ed, and rendered every panel blank. Every asset test passed because each fetched the asset directly
capacity called a verified bound 'empirically verified by a genuine reservation' even in fixture replay, where nothing was reserved — the product overstating its own evidence
